context.task: Challenge next-method combinations and priorities using the accepted81-entry historical audit; review prospective recording without scientific execution.
context.acceptance_scope: Recommendation/record accuracy and defensible engineering sequencing only. No new mathematical proof, physical fidelity, actual-surface root completeness, native integration, performance or probability-of-success acceptance.

summary.assessment: The proposed sequence uses the closest existing implementation evidence while retaining target admission, complete-event and ownership gates. It does not presume the incumbent spline is physical ground truth, transfer represented-P00 timing to repaired CAD, or treat accepted polynomial/scheduler references as a complete physical tracker.
summary.recommended_sequence: Freeze target contracts and shared witnesses; small spline-exclusion and represented-facet event experiments first. Establish actual-source Fourier reconstruction alongside spline work. Follow with the bounded ruled-face reference and common-target quartic/torus ablation. Keep the constant-metric offset lane optional and restricted.
summary.execution_in_this_review: None. File reads, byte/hash/link/metadata consistency checks only; no scientific tests, builds, simulations, acquisition, SSH or process interventions.

detailed_findings.title: Geometry/input admission is coequal with complete events
detailed_findings.detail: Actual VMEC coefficients/modes and coil CAD/sections/frames must be bound before target claims. The independent source reference begins alongside spline optimization; represented-solid correctness alone cannot qualify the physical target.

detailed_findings.title: Q01 and Q02 do not already compose into an irrational-root event tracker
detailed_findings.detail: Q02 returns nonpoint isolating intervals for some complete polynomial results. Q01 scalar composition keeps them UNRESOLVED. Plan explicitly requires separately reviewed interval ordering/refinement, unknown-prefix retention, ties/owners and rounding; midpoint substitution is forbidden.

detailed_findings.title: Ruled rational cubic faces need a degree-six reference
detailed_findings.detail: Q02 is limited to degree<=4. M17 degree<=6 applies to its admitted ruled rational cubic family after positive-denominator clearing. Six crossings may reverse parameter-versus-ray ordering, and endcaps/incident-face/one-sided membership must be retained. Crease normals alone need not determine whole-solid native sense.

detailed_findings.title: Candidate fits require conservative actual-surface authority
detailed_findings.detail: Cartesian admission and actual-target refinement alone do not prove every preceding prefix empty. Plan retains coverage/seam uncertainty, coefficient and ray-substitution uncertainty, grazing error, polynomial-miss/actual-hit controls, and the admitted extra quartic sheet. Old attempt0002/0003 fit errors used different targets and cannot rank their families.

detailed_findings.title: Saved timing and bitwise results are narrower than new optimization hypotheses
detailed_findings.detail: 3.3x is synthetic total Python candidate-search motivation, not isolated evaluator or native gain. v5 bitwise checks are not an exclusion certificate; v3 remains individually UNDECIDED. Complete unknown/exception/fallback cost and robust timing are retained. Prefix/cache gains with differing denominators are not multiplied.

detailed_findings.title: M22 failed-sense probe lacks an input-bound witness
detailed_findings.detail: The retained report records failed sense despite eleven agreeing distances, but not the exact point/direction. Final recommendations and clarified registry require diagnostic input recovery before freezing a regression. Initial registry bytes are preserved; correction/revision and an appended clarification event record the distinction.

record_checks.future_recording: Fresh exclusively created attempt/run paths; source/input/bank/protocol hashes, raw output/stderr/exit/denominators, all negatives and dispositions, appended terminal/review events; retries and changed protocols get new run identities.

remaining_limitations: The ranking is engineering judgment from retained implementation evidence, not a demonstrated fastest method or a probability estimate.
Actual-source geometry, fidelity budgets, per-execution frozen inputs and complete-query oracles remain prerequisites to be established, not results of this plan.
No interval-valued event scheduler or separately admitted degree-six reference was implemented or accepted here.

Rectangular face representation must be bound to the actual pack and its native directional sense/material/score semantics; general twist laws and unsupported denominators are not admitted by analogy.
The restricted M11 scalar reference retains nine normal/projection gaps and miss-only imported rows; it is not a physical rectangular fallback.
Different solids/source banks and same-defect bitwise matches cannot establish physical equivalence or transfer performance acceptance.
Future append-only recording is a prescribed convention, not proof that future executors will preserve every artifact. No resource acquisition/build/remote authorization follows from this plan.
External primary-source links provide context; this review challenges decisive retained local records and does not perform a new literature or current-runtime audit.
